prepSteps.title: Create an ISC API client
prepSteps.instruction: In SailPoint ISC, create an API client for Entro, copy Tenant URL, Client ID, and Client Secret into the operator vault, and confirm outbound HTTPS from the Connector.
prepSteps.evidence: ISC shows the Entro API client (secret stored outside the session)
